shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | head -100
cat node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---NEXT---"; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"version"'; echo "---git diff pkg---"; git diff package.json

node -e "
const r = require('react');
console.log('react keys with unstable/ViewTransition:', Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/nstable|ViewTransition|Activity/.test(k)));
" 2>&1 | head -20
echo "=== next vendored react dirs ==="
ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/ | grep -iE '^react' | head -20
echo "=== grep ViewTransition in next vendored react ==="
grep -rlo "unstable_ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react*/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== files in vendored react-experimental ==="
ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/
echo "=== grep ViewTransition ==="
grep -rl "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/ 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== check export in cjs ==="
grep -o "exports\.[A-Za-z_]*ViewTransition[A-Za-z_]*" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head
echo "=== next's own viewTransition support ==="
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace
echo "=== search viewTransition across next dist (excluding compiled) ==="
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/compiled/' | head -20
echo
echo "=== types ==="
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10

cd /workspace
echo "=== ViewTransition refs (non-compiled) ==="
grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/compiled/' | grep -v bundle-analyzer | head -30
echo
echo "=== startViewTransition ==="
grep -rln "startViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/compiled/' | head -10

cd /workspace
echo "=== next version/dir sanity ==="
ls node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts && wc -l node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts
echo "=== experimental keys mentioning transition/react ==="
grep -niE "transition|reactCompiler|ppr|taint" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -30
echo "=== canary experimental react selection ==="
grep -rn "react-experimental" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -10

cd /workspace
echo "=== exports.ViewTransition in vendored STABLE react ==="
grep -o "exports\.ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/*.js | sort -u | head
echo "=== needsExperimentalReact ==="
grep -rn "needsExperimentalReact" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v compiled | head -10
echo "=== impl ==="
cat node_modules/next/dist/lib/needs-experimental-react.js 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace
echo "=== @types/react version ==="
grep '"version"' node_modules/@types/react/package.json
echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react ==="
grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== react-dom vendored: view transition internals ==="
grep -c "startViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js 2>/dev/null
echo "=== view-transition-name in react-dom ==="
grep -o "viewTransitionName" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head

cd /workspace
echo "=== canary.d.ts head ==="
sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
echo "=== declared ViewTransition const/function in canary.d.ts ==="
grep -nE "ViewTransition:|const ViewTransition|function ViewTransition|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== experimental.d.ts refs ==="
grep -nE "ViewTransition|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== addTransitionType in vendored react ==="
grep -o "exports\.addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u
grep -o "exports\.unstable_addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u
echo "=== all exports in vendored react.production.js ==="
grep -o "^exports\.[A-Za-z_0-9]*" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u
echo "=== tsconfig ==="
cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace
D=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js
echo "=== view-transition-class ==="
grep -o "view-transition-class" $D | sort -u
echo "=== active-view-transition-type ==="
grep -o "active-view-transition-type" $D | sort -u
echo "=== startViewTransition call sites (context) ==="
grep -o ".\{180\}startViewTransition.\{200\}" $D | head -5
echo "=== types: ==="
grep -o "types:[a-zA-Z_$.]\{0,30\}" $D | sort -u | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== Link onNavigate in types ==="
grep -n "onNavigate" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== onNavigate usage in link impl ==="
grep -n "onNavigate\|startTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js | head -30

cd /workspace
echo "=== transitionTypes in link.d.ts ==="
grep -n -B6 -A3 "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts
echo
echo "=== linkClicked impl lines 40-95 ==="
sed -n '40,95p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js

cd /workspace
echo "=== addTransitionType in next client (non-compiled) ==="
grep -rn "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v /esm/ | head -20
echo
echo "=== navigator.js transitionTypes ==="
grep -n "transitionTypes\|addTransitionType\|startTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigator.js | head -40

cd /workspace
sed -n '60,110p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/sequential-router-queue.js
echo "=== useRouter push with transitionTypes? ==="
grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client --include=*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v /esm/ | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== concurrent-router-queue navigate impl ==="
sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/concurrent-router-queue.js | grep -n "transitionTypes\|addTransitionType\|function navigate" 
echo "=== which queue is used ==="
grep -rn "sequential-router-queue\|concurrent-router-queue" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigator.js | head
echo "=== navigator.js content ==="
cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigator.js | head -60

cd /workspace
grep -n -A22 "^function restore\|^function traverse" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/sequential-router-queue.js | head -60

cd /workspace
sed -n '44,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright yes')}catch{console.log('no playwright')}" 2>&1; node -e "try{require.resolve('puppeteer');console.log('puppeteer yes')}catch{console.log('no puppeteer')}" 2>&1

cd /workspace
echo "=== turbopack import map: react alias ==="
grep -rn "compiled/react" node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== is turbopack default in next 16? ==="
grep -rn "bundler" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -5

node -e "
const p=require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json');
console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:p.exports,typesVersions:p.typesVersions,types:p.types},null,2).slice(0,1200))
"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
timeout 480 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- server log ---"; cat /tmp/next.log

cd /workspace
echo "=== / status ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/home.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/
echo "=== /product/classic-sneakers status ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/detail.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers
echo "=== grid markup ==="; grep -o 'class="product-card"[^>]*' /tmp/home.html | head -2
echo "=== product-image divs ==="; grep -c 'product-image' /tmp/home.html
echo "=== hero on detail ==="; grep -o 'class="product-hero"[^>]*' /tmp/detail.html
echo "=== skeleton present in streamed detail? ==="; grep -c 'skeleton-text' /tmp/detail.html
echo "=== server errors ==="; grep -iE "error|warn|undefined" /tmp/next.log | head

cd /workspace
echo "=== thumbnails with vt-name (home) ==="
grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-[a-z-]*"' /tmp/home.html | sort
echo
echo "=== full vt-* attr sets on home ==="
grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c
echo
echo "=== full vt-* attr sets on detail ==="
grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' /tmp/detail.html | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
for f in ('/tmp/home.html','/tmp/detail.html'):
    print('='*20, f)
    html = open(f).read()
    for m in re.finditer(r'<(\w+)([^>]*\bvt-[a-z]+="[^"]*"[^>]*)>', html):
        attrs = m.group(2)
        cls = re.search(r'class="([^"]*)"', attrs)
        vts = re.findall(r'(vt-[a-z]+="[^"]*")', attrs)
        print(f'  <{m.group(1)} class={cls.group(1) if cls else None!r}>  ' + ' '.join(vts))
EOF

cd /workspace
CSS=$(grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' /tmp/home.html | head -1)
echo "css asset: $CSS"
curl -s "http://localhost:3111$CSS" -o /tmp/built.css
wc -c /tmp/built.css
echo "=== view-transition selectors in built css ==="
grep -o '::view-transition-[a-z-]*([^)]*)' /tmp/built.css | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== reduced motion block ==="
grep -o 'prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*{.\{0,400\}' /tmp/built.css
echo "=== custom props ==="
grep -o '\-\-vt-[a-z-]*:[^;]*' /tmp/built.css | sort -u

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'EOF'
css = open('/tmp/built.css').read()
i = css.index('--vt-duration')
out = css[i-20:]
# crude pretty print
out = out.replace('}', '}\n')
print(out)
EOF

cd /workspace
echo "=== transitionTypes in RSC payload (home) ==="
grep -o 'transitionTypes[^,]\{0,60\}' /tmp/home.html | head -4
echo "=== nav-forward present ==="
grep -c 'nav-forward' /tmp/home.html
echo "=== transitionTypes / nav-back (detail) ==="
grep -o 'transitionTypes[^,]\{0,60\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -4

cd /workspace
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo "TSC OK"
timeout 480 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo "TSC OK" && timeout 480 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -14

cd /workspace
grep -o 'prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.*' .next/static/chunks/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -1 || find .next -name '*.css' -path '*static*' -exec grep -l reduced-motion {} \;
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git status --short
git diff app/ tsconfig.json

cd /workspace
(npx next dev -p 3122 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12
curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3122/
curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3122/product/leather-backpack
sleep 4
echo "=== dev log ==="
cat /tmp/dev.log
echo "=== warnings/errors ==="
grep -inE "warn|error|invalid|expects|single child" /tmp/dev.log | head -20 || echo "(none)"

cd /workspace
kill $(pgrep -f "next-server\|next dev" 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
git status --short
echo "=== tsconfig re-touched by dev? ==="
git diff --stat tsconfig.json
